editorial:
Imagine finding a job ad for a housekeeper, applying for it, and then getting rejected just because you are a man. That is exactly what happens in this quirky little gem. You get to follow a guy who is tired of being unemployed and decides to challenge a tough female lawyer who only wants a woman for the job. He does not just walk away, though. He actually takes her to court to sue her for sex discrimination, claiming he is just as good at cleaning as any woman. It is a lighthearted battle of the sexes that feels like a cozy throwback to old-school TV comedies.

The acting is surprisingly charming and the chemistry between the two leads keeps the story moving along nicely. While the pacing is a bit slow in the middle, the funny arguments in the courtroom make up for it. It is a great pick if you want something relaxing and sweet for a weekend afternoon.
endingExplained: After all the legal fighting and arguing, the two main characters realize they actually have a lot in common. The tension turns into romance as they stop seeing each other as enemies. In the end, the lawsuit is settled not with a big check, but with a relationship. They decide to put their differences aside and start dating, proving that love is more important than winning a court case over a cleaning job.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sweet romantic comedies and old TV movies.
